 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The divider row separates two masks; mark cells occupied in either with 3.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == 2 or bottom[r][c] == 1 else 0
             for c in range(len(top[r]))]
            for r in range(len(top))]

if __name__ == '__main__':
